summary: Frontend-only verification of Google OAuth compliance fix (MillEntry Backup product card + verbatim drive.file callout on /privacy). All 8 acceptance criteria PASSED. Homepage renders Products section between Services and Process with both cards (MillEntry, MillEntry Backup); MEB card contains tagline 'Google Drive cloud backup for MillEntry' and mentions 'drive.file'. Privacy page renders with a highlighted callout (data-testid='privacy-drive-file-callout') placed BEFORE '1. Summary' and contains every required verbatim phrase exactly. /terms still loads (h1 = 'Terms of Service'). No React/console errors on homepage load. Section DOM order confirmed: services (y=1475) < products (y=2804) < process (y=3369) < portfolio < pricing < faq < contact.
critical_code_review_comments: Products.tsx: MEB card has an anchor <a href='/privacy'> nested inside a reveal-animated card; the parent card intercepts pointer events during CSS transform animation (Playwright click was blocked mid-animation). Real users can still click after animation settles, but consider adding pointer-events:none to the decorative overlay or z-index:1 on the anchor to be safe.
App.tsx routing is pathname-based (no history API); back/forward across /privacy ↔ / triggers full reload. Fine for a small marketing site but a real router would improve UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth compliance verified. All verbatim phrases on /privacy callout matched case-sensitively. If Google reviewer re-verifies, both required signals are present on the public site: (1) 'MillEntry Backup' text appears on homepage inside Products section, (2) drive.file scope explanation is in a prominent callout at top of /privacy above numbered sections.
